content_sections.heading: High Court of Meghalaya Vacancy Details 2026
What is High Court of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: High Court of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 is conducted for appointment to various posts in the High Court of Meghalaya, Shillong and High Court Legal Services Committee. The recruitment offers opportunities for candidates having qualifications in Law, Library Science, Graduation with Stenography skills and candidates with driving experience.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Meghalaya Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognized University. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in Legal Aid/Services for not less than 3 years. Maximum Age Limit: 32 years for General Category and 37 years for SC/ST category. Bachelor Degree from a recognized University. Diploma in Stenography in English. Minimum shorthand speed of 120 words per minute. Typing speed of 50 words per minute in computer. Bachelor Degree or Diploma in Library Science from a recognized University. Proficiency in computer usage. SSLC passed from a recognized Board. Valid license for Light Motor Vehicle and Transport Vehicle. Knowledge of roadside repairs and efficiency in driving. Minimum 3 years experience after obtaining valid driving license.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Meghalaya Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years. Maximum Age for General Category: 32 years. Maximum Age for SC/ST Category: 37 years.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Meghalaya Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process may include written examination, skill tests and personal interview depending on the post applied for. Stenographer Grade I: Written examination, speed/typing test and interview as applicable. Driver: Driving test and other selection stages as notified. Other posts: Selection will be conducted as per High Court recruitment procedure.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Meghalaya Application Fee 2026
How to Apply for High Court of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of High Court of Meghalaya. Click on the Online Application option. Complete the one-time registration process if applying for the first time. Login and fill the application form. Upload required details and submit the application. Pay the application fee through available payment modes.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in High Court of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available for Stenographer Grade I, Legal Assistant, Library Assistant and Driver posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for High Court of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 24 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for High Court of Meghalaya Legal Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognized University. Preference is given to candidates having experience in Legal Aid/Services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of High Court of Meghalaya posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Level-3 ₹20,600/- to Level-16 ₹49,000/- according to the post.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for High Court of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website of the High Court of Meghalaya.
